dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline fitting the trailing edge from the basal insertion to the acute apex, producing a distinct falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute tip with a minimal pixel radius, indicating a sharp morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex anterior margin with a steep angular incline relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the visible body segment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height significantly exceeds the base width at the point of insertion.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small notch or morphological irregularity visible on the trailing edge of the fin just below the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Field of high-contrast white punctate markings concentrated along the lower longitudinal margin of the body and the posterior base of the fin.
